sources.title: How to bring your AI Model to Android devices
sources.snippet: Bring your AI models to Android devices using Google's AI Edge platform, with tools and frameworks for building, deploying, and optimizing AI models.

sources.title: Google says these AI models are best for coding Android apps
sources.snippet: Google says that its goal is to show which AI models work best for Android app development, as existing benchmarks don't cover the challenges a developer might face while working on Android apps.

sources.title: AI on Android | Android Developers
sources.snippet: Android is evolving into an intelligence system, powered by AI. Integrate your app through a self-service model, and become part of the next generation of intelligent experiences on Android.

sources.title: Gemini AI models - Android Developers
sources.snippet: Integrate cloud-based Gemini Pro and Flash models into Android apps using Firebase AI Logic for multimodal inference.
